description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B\+ business and one of the fastest\-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.  

  

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.  

  

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off\-the\-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.  

  

We're an AI\-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software end to end — working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
* Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
* Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
* Own operational excellence for what you build — monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

  

A day in the life  

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday\-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.  

  

About the team  

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. title: Senior SCALA Developer
description:
About This Role
**4 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: SCALA**

**Overview**
------------


The client uses the Scala Digital Signage platform in a highly customized manner. While Scala's networking, player\-management, publishing, and status capabilities are generally used as designed, most of the content displayed on screen is generated programmatically. Scala's native content\-authoring tools provide the presentation shell, while custom Python software controls much of the actual content, behavior, event processing, and external\-system interaction.


An engineer supporting this environment must first understand how to design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot an enterprise\-scale digital signage system. This includes recognizing normal production behavior, identifying conditions that require intervention, and diagnosing issues across the signage platform, players, networking, content, data sources, and display hardware.


The engineer must understand Scala Content Manager and its use of FrameSets, Screen Regions, Playlists, Channels, Scheduling, and Content to organize and publish presentations. They must also understand Scala's content\-creation environment, content deployment and troubleshooting, metadata\-driven configuration, and the mechanisms used to execute Python applications within Scala content.


Because the majority of the client's dynamic content is generated programmatically, advanced Python software\-development skills are essential. The current implementation uses an object\-oriented, class\-based architecture designed to support multiple content variations while sharing a common application platform.


A major portion of the environment has been modernized from tightly coupled, content\-specific Python applications into a reusable software architecture. Shared functionality such as event handling, network communication, configuration, logging, data processing, and common runtime services is implemented in reusable Python libraries. Individual signage applications primarily define content\-specific behavior while relying on the shared framework for the underlying infrastructure. This substantially improves maintainability, consistency, reliability, and the ability to develop new signage applications without duplicating large amounts of code.


The environment also requires network\-level Python development, including socket\-based communication used to access the Vision system backend and associated APIs. This role may also involve integrating specialized hardware and device drivers into the Scala environment. Candidates should therefore have experience designing, packaging, deploying, and supporting production Python applications and the tooling and automation required to maintain them.


**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------


* Develop, maintain, and enhance the client's Scala Digital Signage applications and supporting Python software.
* Design and maintain reusable Python libraries and application frameworks used across multiple signage solutions.
* Integrate signage applications with external systems, APIs, data sources, databases, and specialized sensors or hardware.
* Develop and support event\-processing, socket\-based communication, and network\-integration logic.
* Support Scala Content Manager, Scala Player, content deployment, configuration, publishing, and production operations.
* Diagnose production issues across application code, Scala components, players, networking, external data sources, sensors, and display hardware.
* Design new signage solutions while preserving compatibility with the existing client architecture.
* Work directly with client business and technical stakeholders to translate operational requirements into production solutions.
* Provide technical guidance for deployment, troubleshooting, support, and future expansion of the digital signage environment.

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Strong Python software\-development and software\-architecture experience are essential. Candidates must be capable of designing and maintaining reusable libraries and production applications rather than simply modifying existing scripts.
* Experience with enterprise digital signage, Scala Digital Signage, networked applications, APIs, event\-driven systems, socket programming, hardware integration, distributed\-system troubleshooting, and Windows\-based production environments.
* Because the client's implementation is highly customized, the role requires an engineer capable of understanding and troubleshooting the system as an integrated whole rather than treating Scala, Python, networking, content, player infrastructure, and external systems as separate disciplines.

**Data \& Integrations Team \| Navan**



Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by consistently prioritizing user needs. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the **Enterprise Team**, you will be a technical leader building the backbone of our corporate travel infrastructure. You will architect and develop the critical systems that allow the world's largest companies to configure, manage, and scale their travel programs—covering everything from complex policy engines and approval workflows to user lifecycle management and enterprise analytics.



This is a high\-impact engineering role where you will solve complex logic and scalability challenges. You will ensure that our platform can handle sophisticated corporate rules and seamless integrations for massive global organizations. You'll collaborate closely with a talented team of engineers, product managers, and architects to design and build innovative solutions that empower our customers to manage their travel spend effectively.


**What You'll Do**


* **Architect Enterprise Core Services:** Design, build, and evolve the backend microservices that power the "brain" of the corporate travel platform—specifically the engines responsible for travel policies, dynamic approval workflows, and compliance enforcement.
* **Build Data\-Driven Services:** Design and develop highly scalable APIs and data processing services that manage high volumes of data, power reporting features, and enable seamless integrations with both internal and external systems.
* **Own Systems End\-to\-End:** Take technical ownership of a problem domain, architecting, developing, and launching key backend features and microservices that have a direct impact on our users and business operations.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Work cross\-functionally with various engineering, product, and business teams to deliver complex, cross\-domain features in a collaborative, global environment.
* **Drive the Technical Vision:** Partner with engineering and product leadership to define and execute the long\-term technical roadmap for our data platform. Be a subject matter expert on backend architecture, distributed systems, and data integration patterns.
* **Champion Best Practices:** Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by writing high\-quality, scalable, and well\-tested code. Mentor other engineers on backend development and advocate for best practices in system design, API development, monitoring, and operational reliability.


**What We're Looking For**


* 4\+ years of experience in backend software development, building large\-scale distributed systems for SaaS products or consumer\-facing applications in a fast\-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in backend development using **Java and Spring Boot**, with a strong grasp of JVM fundamentals, performance tuning, and concurrency.
* Proven experience with databases (**SQL and/or NoSQL**), complex data modeling, and query optimization to handle large datasets.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable, resilient applications using **microservices, distributed systems, and event\-driven architectures** on cloud platforms (**AWS** preferred).
* Demonstrates strong technical ownership and a collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a proven ability to ship production\-quality services equipped with robust testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* A passion for investigating and solving challenging problems in system scalability and data integrity, with a willingness to learn and utilize new tools and technologies.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, CodeGPT, Claude, and Cursor) to accelerate development and innovate on engineering workflows while maintaining high standards for code quality.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands\-on experience.


**Bonus Points For**


* Experience with AI/ML technologies, particularly in building backend systems to support agentic AI, LLM\-based features, or autonomous workflows.
* Deep familiarity with data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis), ETL processes, and reporting systems.
* Experience with performance and scalability testing for high\-throughput services.
* Familiarity with travel industry concepts (e.g., bookings, inventory, integrations with GDS or other suppliers).
